name: bottle-oil-plain
prompt: A tall slender glass bottle of golden cooking oil standing upright, the clear glass filled with bright golden oil, a black screw cap on top, and a plain cream paper label wrapped around the middle of the bottle with no printing on it, the label completely blank with no brand name, no words and no graphics, the bottle filling about two thirds of the frame height. Soft 3D render in a premium product-illustration style: matte clay-like materials with real surface detail, studio softbox lighting from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion and a soft contact shadow, three-quarter view, centred with generous margin so nothing touches the frame edges, natural colours with fresh green accents, calm and modern like Apple or Monzo marketing art. Transparent background with no floor surface, only the soft contact shadow. No people, no hands. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
postprocess: contact shadow: pale see-through pixels outside the object recoloured to #0b1510 at 62% of their alpha, so the shadow reads as shadow on light and dark grounds (14583 px at 1024); then a 768x768 WebP, cwebp -q 85 -alpha_q 100 -resize 768 768; the PNG original stays local in src/
